_howto: Our lineout setup. slots are drawn left (front, near touch) to right (back). Edit names and text here.

slots.label: FL
slots.name: Front lifter
slots.text: Lifts the jumper from the front. Lift on the thighs/shorts, hold, and bring the jumper down safely.

slots.label: L/J
slots.name: Lifter / jumper
slots.text: Hybrid spot. Depending on the call, you jump or you lift.

slots.label: L/J
slots.name: Lifter / jumper
slots.text: Hybrid spot. Depending on the call, you jump or you lift.

slots.label: BL
slots.name: Back lifter
slots.text: Lifts the jumper from the back. Lift on the thighs/shorts, hold, and bring the jumper down safely.

slots.label: Pod
slots.name: Back pod
slots.text: Everyone not lifting or jumping. In a pod at the back, ready to receive the ball or be a dummy.

slots.label: Pod
slots.name: Back pod
slots.text: Everyone not lifting or jumping. In a pod at the back, ready to receive the ball or be a dummy.

slots.label: Pod
slots.name: Back pod
slots.text: Everyone not lifting or jumping. In a pod at the back, ready to receive the ball or be a dummy.

hooker: You throw in at every lineout. This is the one set job in our lineout. Straight down the middle!
nine: Receiver. Wait just off the lineout for the ball from the jumper, or from the back of a maul.
backs: Backs stand 10 meters back from the lineout until it's over.
anyForward: On the Phins, any forward can be a lifter, a jumper, or in the back pod. Your spot comes from the call, not your number.
note: Every call has a front lifter, a back lifter, and two lifter/jumpers in the middle. Everyone else is in the back pod. Maul calls change this setup.
